name: Heronite v1.1.1
body:
**Linux:** `Heronite-x86_64.AppImage` runs on any distribution (recommended). Or the package for your system: `.deb` (Debian, Ubuntu, Mint), `.rpm` (Fedora, openSUSE), `.pkg.tar.zst` (Arch, CachyOS).

**Windows 10 and 11:** `Heronite-Setup-x86_64.exe` installs Heronite for your user, no administrator rights needed (recommended). `Heronite-Portable-x86_64.zip` runs from any folder you extract it to and keeps its library and settings in that folder. They are not code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may say "Windows protected your PC": choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**.

## ✨ What's new

- **App icons:** choose from three app icons in Settings → Appearance
- **New ways to install:** Heronite is now available on Fedora COPR and through Scoop on Windows
- **Better Flatpak integration:** notifications now use the system's notification portal

## 🛠 Improvements

- Performance and stability improvements
- Better compatibility across Linux distributions and package formats
- Updates from AUR, COPR and Scoop are now handled by their own package managers
- Launchers pick up the new icon right after installing or changing it
- Tray icon is back to the plain H

name: Heronite v1.1.0
body:
**Linux:** `Heronite-x86_64.AppImage` runs on any distribution (recommended). Or the package for your system: `.deb` (Debian, Ubuntu, Mint), `.rpm` (Fedora, openSUSE), `.pkg.tar.zst` (Arch, CachyOS).

**Windows 10 and 11:** `Heronite-Setup-x86_64.exe` installs Heronite for your user, no administrator rights needed (recommended). `Heronite-Portable-x86_64.zip` runs from any folder you extract it to and keeps its library and settings in that folder. They are not code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may say "Windows protected your PC": choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**.

`SHA256SUMS` lists the SHA-256 of every file (signed in `SHA256SUMS.minisig`). The `.minisig` and `.zsync` files are for the updaters; you do not need them.


## ✨ Highlights

- **Xbox and PC Game Pass on Windows:** Microsoft Store and Game Pass games appear in your Collection, launch from Heronite and track playtime
- **More stores on Windows:** Battle.net, EA app, Ubisoft Connect and Rockstar Games Launcher run natively. Heronite uses the client you already have or installs it with the official installer
- **Playnite import:** bring in your Playnite games on Windows and track the games it launches
- **Heronite Cloud:** keep your library in sync between PCs
  - Syncs your library, playtime and sessions through your own cloud account
  - Sends backups, game saves and screenshots to the cloud, manually or automatically
  - Set up a new PC by restoring everything from the cloud
  - A "play-only" mode lets a PC send just its playtime and sessions
  - Guided setup in Settings → Cloud
- **Flatpak support:** Heronite now runs as a Flatpak, launching Steam and Flatpak emulators from the host

## 🛠 Improvements

- Simpler Achievements settings: emulators shown in a grid, and RetroAchievements sign-in explains what it brings
- Simpler Replay settings: main options up front, a notice when gpu-screen-recorder is missing, and the rest under Show advanced
- Background and panel options in the view menu, with new appearance defaults
- Updates are checked against the release's signed SHA256SUMS

## 🐛 Fixes

- Epic login fixed on Linux
- NixOS uses legendary, gogdl and nile from PATH
- Heroic Flatpak games are imported when the native install has none
- Restoring a backup keeps the PC's identity for sync

> New app ID (`app.heronite.Heronite`): if Heronite is pinned to your dock, unpin it and pin it again.

# 🪟 Heronite is now on Windows!

Heronite now runs natively on Windows, with the same library, stores, emulators and features you know from Linux. Download the installer or the portable zip. Both update themselves.

## What works on Windows

- **Stores:** Steam, Epic, GOG and Amazon Games run natively, with cloud saves. Games already installed by the Steam, Epic Games Launcher, GOG Galaxy and Amazon Games apps are imported automatically
- **Emulation:** emulators, ROM folders and save states, found on every drive
- **Backups:** save backups through Ludusavi, and your Linux backups restore on Windows
- **Everyday features:** screenshots, tray icon, start with Windows, Desktop and Start menu shortcuts, and heronite:// links
- **Storage manager:** Windows drives, folder sizes and the Recycle Bin
- **Clean interface:** only the options that work on Windows are shown

## ✨ Also new

- Custom window controls on Windows and Linux
- Add all games found in a folder at once
- More view options in the header, with "Reset to defaults"
- Simpler Actions tab in game settings
- Default screenshots folder until you choose one
- Steam listed first among stores
- Refresh the Collection from the ☰ menu

## ✨ Highlights

- **Drag and drop:** drop a file or folder onto the window to add a game

name: Heronite v0.15.0
body:
**Download:** `Heronite-x86_64.AppImage` runs on any distribution (recommended). Or the package for your system: `.deb` (Debian, Ubuntu, Mint), `.rpm` (Fedora, openSUSE), `.pkg.tar.zst` (Arch, CachyOS). The `.minisig` and `.zsync` files are for the updaters; you do not need them.

## ✨ Highlights

- **Console mode themes:** fully customizable console mode with four built-in themes (Minimal, Classic, Cinema and Pulse). Create your own, save it, and share it via JSON export/import
  - Layouts include Carousel, Cinema, Spotlight, Wheel, Grid and Dashboard, with a live Customize panel
  - Button glyphs for Xbox, PlayStation, Nintendo, Steam Deck and keyboard, plus an A/B swap option
  - Filters panel on Y, UI sounds, an idle screen, and auto-start when a controller connects
- **Light theme and custom themes:** choose Light, Dark or System, build your own six-colour theme, or use your desktop's accent colour
- **Automatic Proton:** downloads the latest GE-Proton when none is installed and keeps the -latest builds up to date
- **Spanish** interface language

## 🛠 Improvements

- Keyboard shortcut to save a replay
- Fetch metadata from the Game tab
- Tooltips on icon-only buttons and a loading pulse on covers
- Other launchers appear in Getting started

## ⚡ Performance

- Faster startup, with the library loading while the window opens
- Less memory use in the tray, plus fixed thread leaks
- Lower GPU usage from capped animation frame rates and freed textures

name: Heronite v0.14.0
body:

## ✨ Highlights

- **Import from other launchers:** bring in your games from Heroic, Lutris, Faugus and Bottles. Heronite can launch them through the original launcher and still track your playtime
- **Replay buffer:** press Guide + X to save the last moments of gameplay as a replay in the game's journal. Powered by gpu-screen-recorder, with a memory estimate and per-game on/off switch
- **Sandbox:** run games and their Wine programs isolated with bubblewrap, each with its own private home folder. Configurable per game in a new Sandbox tab
- **Merge duplicates:** combine games that appear twice, carrying over playtime, status and notes

## 🛠 Improvements

- Simpler Add game dialog, with install scripts and sandbox options built in
- Install scripts can run inside the sandbox
- Sandbox homes are left out of backups and removed with the game
- The Collection opens in Grid until you pick another view
- Fewer disk writes and lighter replay defaults

## 🐛 Fixes

- Several fixes to replay recording, sandbox permissions and launcher imports

- Resizable Focus list and grid drawer
- Automatic switch between Grid and Focus based on window width
- The empty Collection shows the games found on your PC
